title: Broccoli, frozen, cooked, no added fat

content.title: About
content.content: Broccoli is the edible flower head of Brassica oleracea var. italica. Frozen, cooked broccoli with no added fat retains most of its nutrients, a mild flavor and a firm texture after reheating.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Broccoli belongs to the cruciferous family, which also includes cabbage, cauliflower and Brussels sprouts.
Flash‑freezing right after a short blanching step helps preserve vitamin C and other antioxidants.
It is often called a “super‑vegetable” because of its high levels of vitamins, minerals and phytochemicals.
In the United States, broccoli is one of the top‑selling frozen vegetables.
There are green and purple varieties; the purple type contains more anthocyanins.

items.title: Rich in vitamin C
items.content: Vitamin C supports the immune system and aids collagen synthesis.

items.title: Contains vitamin K
items.content: Vitamin K is essential for blood clotting and bone health.

items.title: Source of folate
items.content: Folate is needed for DNA synthesis and is especially important during pregnancy.

items.title: Provides dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber promotes healthy digestion and helps maintain satiety.

items.title: Phytochemicals
items.content: Sulforaphane and other glucosinolates have antioxidant and anti‑inflammatory properties.

items.title: Cruciferous allergy
items.content: A small number of people may experience an allergic reaction to broccoli.

items.title: Gas production
items.content: Broccoli contains raffinose, which can cause bloating in sensitive individuals.

items.title: Nitrate content
items.content: Improper storage can increase nitrate levels; use the product before the expiration date.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Heat the frozen broccoli by steaming, microwaving, or boiling for 3–5 minutes. Serve as a side dish, add to soups, stews, salads or whole‑grain bowls. A squeeze of lemon, herbs or a drizzle of olive oil can enhance the flavor.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep frozen at –18 °C. Once the package is opened, use within 6–8 months. Do not thaw and refreeze to avoid quality loss.
